title: API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails
abstract: arXiv:2610.36801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to cent

translated_title: API-TAIL：通过温度对齐的似然尾部检测大语言模型API中的模型替换
translated_abstract: 商业语言模型API仅返回文本，这使得服务提供商可以通过悄悄地将一部分用户请求路由到更便宜的替代模型、同时按所宣传的模型收费来削减成本。检测这种部分替换非常具有挑战性，因为诚实的提供商也会通过未公开的解码和服务配置选择（例如温度缩放、采样截断、重复惩罚与存在惩罚、默认系统提示词等）改变输出分布，这迫使审计必须针对合法配置构成的复合零假设进行检验，而非仅针对单一参考模型。我们的关键洞察是：这些合法的变化主要使整个批次响应的典型性发生偏移，而部分替换则会注入在所声称模型下依然异常的个别响应。基于这一洞察，我们提出了API-TAIL，这是一种典型性审计方法，它首先通过将单一有效温度对齐到中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出API-TAIL典型性审计方法，通过温度对齐吸收合法解码配置造成的批次级偏移，再从似然尾部识别个别异常响应，从而检测LLM API服务中悄悄将部分请求替换为更廉价模型的行为。
en_tdlr: API-TAIL is a typicality audit that detects partial model substitution in LLM APIs by aligning an effective temperature to absorb batch-level shifts from legitimate decoding configurations, then flagging individually anomalous responses in the likelihood tails.
